description: Land Acquisition - Advance Tracing No. GAM/KATA/2016/161 & 160 Kimbulapitiya, Katana D/S Division, Gampaha District
categorisation: This gazette content consists entirely of land acquisition declarations under the Land Acquisition Act. It describes specific parcels of land being acquired for public purposes, including detailed descriptions of land boundaries, locations, and extents. The content focuses exclusively on land matters without involving government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or other specialized categories. The mention of the Minister of Lands is incidental to the land acquisition process rather than being the primary focus of the gazette.
